title: C# Core Gameplay Architecture & Player Controller
acceptanceCriteria: GameManager implements shift timer (180s), game states (Loading, DayActive, DayComplete, Paused), and cleanliness rating (0-100%).
EconomyManager tracks BroCoins and MuscleTips, plus 2x multiplier buff system.
PlayerController supports WASD/Arrow keys and ground click/touch raycasting with 3-item inventory stack.
GuestController models 5 bro archetypes with patience meters, humorous speech barks, and payout on checkout.
Zero compiler errors, adheres to docs/contracts/game-state-schema.json.
